content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should monitor the official careers page for any corrigendum, revised deadline or selection announcement. BEML states that recruitment updates will be published on its website.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The 31-page notification contains position codes, educational qualifications, post-qualification experience requirements, job responsibilities, grade-wise vacancies, age limits, pay scales, application instructions and document requirements. Download BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: BEML has announced 83 executive vacancies across seven grades. The largest number of posts is available in the Grade II Engineer category. The advertised vacancy distribution includes one ST backlog vacancy under Assistant Manager position code 118 and one SC backlog vacancy under Deputy General Manager position code 102. These are included within the advertised total of 83 posts.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, post-qualification experience and age requirements specified for the position code. Eligibility will be determined as on 3 December 2026. Most technical positions require a full-time, first-class Engineering degree in the relevant discipline from a recognised university or institution. The accepted specialisations include Mechanical, Electrical, Electrical and Electronics, Automobile, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Thermal Engineering and other disciplines according to the post. Certain positions require specialised qualifications, such as a postgraduate degree in Hindi or English with the specified language combination, a translation qualification, or recognised safety-related credentials. The notification defines first class as at least 60% aggregate marks across all semesters or years. The qualifying-mark requirement is relaxed by five percentage points for eligible SC, ST and PwD candidates. Applicants with CGPA or credit-based grading must provide the university-approved conversion formula. Important: A general Engineering degree does not make a candidate eligible for every advertised position. Applicants must possess the discipline-specific qualification and technical experience stated against their chosen position code.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Experience Requirements
content_sections.text: BEML requires relevant post-qualification experience for most executive positions. Experience acquired before obtaining the essential qualification will not be counted towards the prescribed requirement. The experience description should clearly explain the projects, assignments, responsibilities, position held and duration. BEML warns that unclear or irrelevant information may lead to rejection of the application.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The grade-wise upper age limits are calculated as on 3 December 2026. BEML states that the maximum age after applicable relaxation cannot exceed 57 years. Candidates seeking reservation or relaxation must provide the prescribed supporting certificates.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: Additional 10 Years, subject to applicable conditions
Relaxation may be considered against excess qualifying experience, subject to the notification

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Salary 2026 - Grade-wise Pay Scale
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive the applicable BEML executive pay scale for their appointed grade. In addition to basic pay, selected employees may receive applicable dearness allowance, company accommodation or house rent allowance, provident fund, gratuity, performance-related pay and other benefits according to company rules. BEML specifies that basic pay is normally fixed at the minimum of the applicable pay scale, although higher starting pay may be considered for deserving candidates. The pay-scale figures should not be interpreted as monthly take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The ₹500 application fee is non-refundable. Candidates required to pay the fee must complete payment through the official online application facility.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: BEML will shortlist eligible candidates for assessment based on the applications received and the relevant eligibility criteria. The company may restrict the number of candidates called for assessment and increase the qualifying percentage depending on the number of applicants. The recruitment process includes the following applicable stages: Screening and shortlisting of eligible applications. Assessment of shortlisted candidates through the process notified by BEML. Verification of original documents and eligibility claims. Pre-employment medical examination. Final selection and appointment, subject to satisfactory verification and medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 NOC Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates employed in Central or State Government departments, autonomous bodies, quasi-government organisations and public sector undertakings must follow the proper-channel or No Objection Certificate requirements prescribed by BEML. Alternatively, they may produce a position-specific NOC from their present employer at the assessment stage. The notification also explains circumstances in which applicants without an NOC may attend the interview, subject to furnishing a proper relieving letter at joining and forgoing certain past-service benefits or pay protection.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the required documents while submitting their online applications. BEML states that applications without the prescribed documents will be rejected. Class 10 marksheet and SSLC certificate showing date of birth. Class 12 marksheet. Qualifying degree certificate and marksheets. CGPA or credit-to-percentage conversion formula, where applicable. Postgraduate degree certificate and marksheets, where applicable. Government-issued identity proof. Detailed resume. Applicable SC, ST, OBC, EWS or PwD certificate. Experience certificates showing the start and end dates of employment. Latest payslip. Current reporting structure for DGM and GM applicants. Company turnover credentials for relevant General Manager applicants. Applicants should ensure the uploaded documents support their claims regarding qualifications, post-qualification experience, reservation and other eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026

Applicants should select the correct position code rather than submitting applications for multiple posts.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in BEML Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEML has advertised 83 executive vacancies across Grade II to Grade VIII, including Engineer, Assistant Manager, Manager, Senior Manager, AGM, DGM and General Manager posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 3 December 2026 at 6:00 PM, according to Advertisement No. KP/S/18/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Most technical posts require a relevant full-time, first-class Engineering degree. Certain positions require specialised qualifications. Candidates must check the educational requirements for their particular position code.

faq.question: Q4. Can freshers apply for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Most advertised posts require relevant post-qualification experience ranging from two to 19 years. However, the grade-wise eligibility table separately specifies no post-qualification experience requirement for the Assistant Manager Medical position, code 123.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for BEML Executive posts?
faq.answer: The advertised pay scales range from ₹40,000–₹1,40,000 for Grade II Engineers to ₹1,00,000–₹2,60,000 for Grade VIII General Manager posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹500 for General, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST and PwD candidates are exempt from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for BEML Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general upper age limit ranges from 29 years for Grade II Engineers to 48 years for Grade VIII General Manager posts. Applicable age relaxations are provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the BEML Executive Recruitment 2026 selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants will be shortlisted for assessment, followed by applicable document verification and pre-employment medical examination. BEML will communicate further selection details through official recruitment updates.
